chapter: Dancers, Newton, Chu Berry and the Cab Calloway band
title: Billy Strayhorn
summary: A casual friendship; the story of 'Upper Manhattan Medical Group'.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: I heard a story once, do you know a Billy tune called 'Upper Manhattan Medical Group'?
I'm told when he started with Duke's band and he said that it was to be played as if you can imagine somebody tap dancing.
Oh God, yes. Sweetpea. Yeah I knew Billy very well. Great arranger.
No question. When did you meet him?
Oh, way back. It was back there when he first, when Duke first got him. I don't know what year that was....
Yeah it was way back then, I knew him back there.
Yeah, mm hmm. I knew him. Billy Strayhorn.

About him, no. Because it was just a casual acquaintance you know, we'd meet, see each other, talk, maybe have a drink together and that would be all. Wasn't ever real tight, you know, but good friends, see each other and talk.
